reviews.x: I bought this for my sister to wear during the duration of her 3-day bachelorette party and was EXTREMELY worried about it looking tacky, but it didn't!  It's metal, so it is durable and actually looks lovely.  The jewels in them are, generally, small enough that they don't look tacky and cheap.  It was perfect for what I was wanting for my sister's party and I would absolutely buy more to use for costumes!

reviews.t: Stunning, fit for a princess or queen
reviews.x: I ordered this for a friend's special birthday.  I thought for the price it would be fun.  When it arrived. I was amazed at how beautiful it was.  It sparkles almost as well as real diamonds.  The friend to whom I gave it is planning on wearing it often.  One caveat, when it arrives, it is tightly packed into a bag.  I used packing material to make a head, then put the tiara  onto it for several days before the event.  I believe it made it more comfortable to wear.  This is a winner.  Don't hesi

reviews.t: This is an adorable tiara! Pretty heavy
reviews.x: This is an adorable tiara!  Pretty heavy, so I wouldn't recommend for a small child, but for a pre-teen to adult person, I would say it is great!

I got this as a gift for my gf to wear at her surprise party for her 30th. She raved about how nice it was. It's sturdy and now flimsy...the stones shine/refract similar to actual diamonds & the finish is top notch. Looks and feels like a way more expensive tiara and, for that, I'm eternally grateful.  Recommend this for sure!
My kids loved the Tiara. It very nicely built and sparkles.

We ordered the crown as a birthday present for our 5 year old niece - aka Princess. The crown arrived quickly and we were very pleased with the quality. It has slightly more heft than expected, which we believe will make it sturdier for a youngster. It glistened in the light and our niece really felt like a Princess. Thank you!

Great little tiara for the price.  I purchased for a 6-year-old's dress-up wardrobe.  It feels solid, looks sparkly and has 2 small combs attached to help secure it. Delivered in a padded mailing bag but came through without damage.  Much better than the plastic one I had seen at a toy shop for a higher price.

reviews.t: fit great and absolutely looked authentic-real
reviews.x: It was firm, fit great and absolutely looked authentic-real. I love it.
The tiara was delivered quickly, was packaged with care and was stunning! High quality item that did not disappoint.  Great price for the quality.

BUYER BEWARE: Arrived damaged and to add insult to injury, Vendor does NOT accept returns - which is simply a violation of the warranty of merchantability of any product. When I opened the package two ‘crystals’ were floating in the bag. The combs on the tiara were misaligned & it was unwearable. Cheaply made product. Definitely NOT Worth the $9 they charge! This Product & Vendor deserve ZERO stars, yet review requires at least one.

This is small enough for a 10-year-old girl, and there's a little give to the back side of the headband, so there's some flexibility. The "diamonds" are all well set—none have fallen out despite plenty of use. It's pretty heavy, but that's to be expected with a tiara this fabulous...
This was surprisingly nice. I thought it was going to look cheap but it looks like a solid piece and my daughter wore it for Halloween.

We were so excited to get this for my daughter for the daddy daughter dance..... she’s 4 and we were so disappointed. It did not fit her head at all! We tried it on my 9 year old step daughter and it didn’t fit her either. And while trying to figure it out one of the sides moved just right and the weld snapped Apart and it broke. Would not order another.
I think that buying this crown is a waste of your time. When I wore it, the next day I had allergies all over my body. I guess you get what you pay for.
The tiara is absolutely stunning but for such a beautiful product, one would think it wouldnt be so poorly packaged. The box came beat up as shown in the picture but the product was fine.
The quality of the crown was much better that I had imagined it would be for the price.

Beautiful crown, but falls apart easily. Bought for my daughter's 9th birthday. She has worn it a handful of times in the 2 weeks she has had it and multiple gems have fallen out and just last night half the crown came apart from the band.

WOW! Hard to believe this beauty was under $10! I fully expected something made of plastic with stones falling off - but this was a substantial weight and the stones were beautiful.  Bought it for my Mom’s 70th, with two other crowns to give her the choice.  Mom picked the Queen crown, put the nature crown on me, and then my handsome nephew jumped in a donned this silver princess crown.  It was so funny. Later, one of our best friends donned the silver princess crown and floated around the party
I bought this tiara just because. I'm the Queen of my house!

I bought this for my 3 almost 4yr old and she loves her princess crown! She wore it to my work party and got so many compliments! Pros: The price was great, it’s very pretty and does not look cheap, it feels very sturdy like it will last, would even be great for a homecoming queen! Cons: It’s a bit stiff, you can’t really re-shape it for a more personal fit but the teeth of the combs can flex a little Overall: Totally worth it, I recommend it and would buy this crown again!

reviews.t: I think every Girl from 9 to 90 should have their own Tiara!
reviews.x: I had to buy 2, this was meant for my Niece's Sweet 16 but I tried it on, it was so pretty I had to order another! I looove it! Fits my head, and my head is big, but it can fit anyone's head, from a preteen to grown up Aunties lol! I looove it, I felt like a queen, and yes I've taken a lot of pictures. I've never worn one before, if you haven't, you must give it a try... my Niece loved hers as well
I love it. It's perfect for my up coming birthday.

So much cuter than pictured. Metal, not plastic. Doesn't look overwhelmingly cheap or super costumey. But, the little comb thingies at the ends of the headband part are super pokey, and are extended a tad farther than necessary. For the price, it's a cute little accessory to add a ridiculous, but cutesy touch to the night. Glad I bought it.

reviews.t: This is a beautiful tiara but as soon as took it out Of ...
reviews.x: This is a beautiful tiara but as soon as took it out Of the package the center stone fell out.

Couldn’t be more happier with the crown. All the crystals stood in place and it had a bright shine to it. You might have to use extra bobby-pins for it to stay in place. The crown could be used for adults and kids.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the tiara's sparkly, high-quality appearance, saying it looks more expensive than it is and resembles real diamonds.
Many note the tiara feels solid, sturdy, and somewhat heavy rather than flimsy.
Several reviewers mention it works well as a gift for children, pre-teens, and adults, though some note it may be too heavy for small children.
A few reviewers report quality and fit problems, including damage on arrival, misaligned combs, poor fit, and an allergic reaction.
Some reviewers comment on packaging, noting it arrived quickly and intact for most, but poorly packaged or beat-up for others.

qa.q: Will it fit my head comfortably?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on fit: one reviewer says it fits her big head and can fit anyone from a preteen to grown-up Aunties [1], while another says it did not fit her 4-year-old or 9-year-old at all [5]. Others note it is small enough for a 10-year-old with some give at the back [2], and that it is a bit stiff and can't really be reshaped for a personal fit [6].

claims.text: One reviewer says it fits her big head and can fit anyone from a preteen to grown-up Aunties.
Another reviewer says it did not fit her 4-year-old or 9-year-old at all.
It is described as small enough for a 10-year-old with some give at the back side of the headband.
It is described as a bit stiff and not really reshapable for a more personal fit.

qa.q: Is it durable enough to last through the event?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on durability: some describe it as sturdy and lasting [2][3][4], while one reports gems falling out and the crown coming apart from the band [1].

claims.text: It is metal and durable, and was perfect for a 3-day party [2].
It is sturdy and not flimsy [3].
It feels very sturdy like it will last [4].
It falls apart easily, with multiple gems falling out and half the crown coming apart from the band [1].

qa.q: Does it feel comfortable to wear for hours?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it safe for a child to wear?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on safety for a small child: one reviewer says it's pretty heavy and wouldn't recommend it for a small child [3], while another bought it for a 3 almost 4-year-old who loves it and found it sturdy [2]. Another notes it's small enough for a 10-year-old with some flexibility [1].

claims.text: It's pretty heavy, so it's not recommended for a small child [3].
It was bought for a 3 almost 4-year-old who loves it and it feels sturdy [2].
It's small enough for a 10-year-old girl with some flexibility in the headband [1].

qa.q: Does it have any weird smell?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.
